steps.name: Fill SMB config
steps.action: Enter host=192.168.0.100, share=media, user=admin in SMB config step
steps.expected: Fields populated

steps.name: Go back then forward
steps.action: Click Back, then click Next to return to SMB config
steps.expected: All previously entered values are preserved

steps.name: Enter invalid host
steps.action: Enter host='<script>alert(1)</script>' in SMB config
steps.expected: Validation error shown, input sanitized, no XSS

steps.name: Test unreachable host
steps.action: Enter host=192.168.99.99 and click Test Connection
steps.expected: Connection attempt times out within 10s, error message shown, not frozen

steps.name: Enter invalid port
steps.action: Set FTP port to 99999
steps.expected: Validation error: port must be 1-65535

steps.name: Enter malformed URL
steps.action: Enter WebDAV URL as 'htp://not valid url'
steps.expected: Validation error about malformed URL format

steps.name: Enter nonexistent path
steps.action: Enter /this/path/does/not/exist as local storage path
steps.expected: Validation error: path does not exist or is not accessible

steps.name: Enter traversal path
steps.action: Enter '../../../etc/passwd' as local storage path
steps.expected: Path traversal detected and blocked, security error shown

steps.name: Scan empty network
steps.action: Start network scan on isolated network with no SMB/NFS devices
steps.expected: Scan completes, shows 'No devices found' message, option to retry or enter manually

steps.name: Save to read-only location
steps.action: Attempt to save configuration to read-only directory
steps.expected: Error message about permissions, suggestion to choose different location

steps.name: Load corrupt config
steps.action: Load a config file containing invalid JSON
steps.expected: Error message about corrupted file, wizard remains functional, no crash

steps.name: Click Next rapidly
steps.action: Click Next button 20 times in rapid succession
steps.expected: Steps advance correctly, no double-processing, final step reached cleanly

steps.name: Start and cancel scan
steps.action: Start network scan, then immediately click Cancel
steps.expected: Scan stops, resources released, wizard returns to previous state

steps.name: Enter special password
steps.action: Enter password 'p@$$w0rd!#%&*()' in SMB config
steps.expected: Password accepted and used correctly in connection test

steps.name: Enter root export
steps.action: Enter '/' as NFS export path
steps.expected: Warning about mounting root filesystem, requires explicit confirmation

steps.name: Configure duplicate storage
steps.action: Add SMB share pointing to same path already configured via NFS
steps.expected: Warning about duplicate storage path detected

steps.name: Skip connection test
steps.action: Fill all fields but skip Test Connection step and click Complete
steps.expected: Warning that connection was not tested, option to proceed anyway or test first

steps.name: Enter very long share
steps.action: Enter 500-character string as SMB share name
steps.expected: Input truncated or validation error, no buffer overflow or crash

steps.name: Enter unicode hostname
steps.action: Enter hostname with Chinese/Arabic characters
steps.expected: Validation error about invalid hostname characters, helpful message shown

steps.name: Lose network during test
steps.action: Start connection test, then disconnect network mid-test
steps.expected: Test fails with timeout/network error, wizard remains usable, retry available

steps.name: Crash mid-wizard
steps.action: Force kill app while on step 4 of wizard
steps.expected: On relaunch, wizard offers to resume from last saved step or start over
